protocol.training: One fresh fit from pinned original weights, two epochs on original4096 plus2048 fixed single-component release views; same Adam/BCE/batch4/seed. Prior epoch2 is a comparator only. More optimizer steps confound attribution to release data alone.
protocol.data: All555 takes retained with their original intended labels: pass1 train200, pass2 calibration200, pass3 test155; all roles anchor every take before random mixtures. Source-disjoint intervals, same instrument/session; previously inspected evidence, not a new blind test.
protocol.windows: Original4096 windows retained verbatim. Each added view uses one distinct parent window; one selected component ends at fixed offset0/1/2/4/8/16 frames before readout164 with110sample taper, original full-crop RMS/gain unchanged. Other components remain exact. Artificial labels end at that boundary. No acoustic-offset labels or original label edits.
protocol.onsets: Original captures start within sustain, so no onset labels are invented. Shared-weight onset changes are measured with the unchanged causal decoder.
protocol.final_model: Epoch2 only; no selection using calibration/test.
protocol.representation: Train precision>=99%, calibration and test>=95%; recall>=80%, exact_set>=70% overall and separately for3/4/5 distinct pitches, silence extras0. Distinct pitch frames, not installed note/string matching.
protocol.source_preservation: Every original source occurrence preserves present frames and longest correct run against both original and prior model; all deltas retained.
protocol.continuous: Prior and release weights, each corrected TensorFlow and cropped ORT at164/165, ordinary and extended-middle once: eight causal passes. Frozen decoder, all88 pitches, original recording level.
protocol.continuous_primary: Measured FIFO worker completion including model, buffer/resample and decoder; source availability is diagnostic only. Sequential paired measurement includes machine timing noise.
protocol.research_acceptance: All representation/source gates; corrected TF versus cropped ORT parity1e-4 for new weights; unchanged per-label presence/hold, false/gap, exact/all-expected gates against saved CURRENT and paired prior model; ordinary gain>=5pp versus CURRENT; cropped service p99<=20ms, queue max<=26.666667ms. No promotion.
protocol.backend: Exact constant-power normalization guard and ORT disabled optimization, opset17,164/165 crop. Three synthetic inputs first, all172 TF/full ONNX frames and bit-identical full/cropped readouts. Synthetic failure skips corpus. Prior numerical/quality failures stay separate.
protocol.limitations: Ordinary reuses source takes and is descriptive, not independent generalization. No strings, equal-pitch unison multiplicity, bend/repluck, native allocation/deadline or DAW/device claim.
protocol.resource: Existing GitHub CPU only;100minute process110minute job; checkpoint every epoch; prior625.9MB artifact extracted on worker only; small reports local, checkpoints and tapes remote.
protocol.evaluation: Original train4096, calibration1024 and test1024 plans unchanged. Evaluate original, prior epoch2 and release epoch2 on every original window; retain all source-occurrence deltas and probabilities. No threshold/model selection.
